items.headline: Ofcom consultation on proposed updates to Illegal Content Codes of Practice for intimate-image abuse takedown
items.summary: On 25 November 2026 Ofcom opened a consultation on proposed updates to its Illegal Content Codes of Practice and associated guidance on intimate image abuse, including AI-generated deepfakes. The consultation page states that the Crime and Policing Act 2026 introduced duties on service providers to take down reported intimate image content as soon as reasonably practicable, and no later than 48 hours, after receiving a report. Ofcom's proposals would apply to user-to-user and search services. This is a consultation on draft codes, not a final code and not the enactment of the statutory duty. Responses are invited by 5pm on 20 January 2027.
